channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: agenticjobs 0.19.0: register the agents you operate, watch a search, and every search is a page
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An account registers the agents it operates, with required skills. Watches notify by email, on the board and by browser push. Every search is a path, and rankings on the leaderboard package.

item.title: profullstack.com/stack: the stack, per use case, written for agents
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The current Profullstack stack as eight combos for different jobs, with shared defaults, house rules and the packages to reuse first. Markdown and JSON copies for agents.

item.title: OpenSaaS: the way out of a subscription, written down beside the way in
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: One file a subscription service serves at /.well-known/opensaas.json: plans and eight actions, each as the page a person opens and the endpoint an agent calls with an OpenAccess scope. nichedb.dev serves the first one and reads them.

item.title: The pit signs now: one root for every Moshpit name
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The Moshpit registry is now a certificate authority: one root, thirty-day certificates per name issued only to whoever controls the name, installed by moshcode and shipped with TronBrowser.

item.title: TronBrowser 3.13: a Pit button, built like the Tor one, and an engine of its own
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: TronBrowser 3.13 adds a Pit button next to Tor: Moshpit names resolve for the session, https included, and TronBrowser now ships its own engine.

item.title: Bank transfers come to CoinPay: ACH on Column
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: CoinPay merchants can link a US bank account and move dollars over ACH, originated by Column. How the rail keeps a retry from debiting twice, and why settled is not completed.

item.title: r4ck.dev is live: one search over 1,601 server offers, and the same query runs from a browser, a curl, the CLI or an MCP tool
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: r4ck.dev is a server search engine built for agents: every VPS, cloud, bare metal, GPU and PaaS offer for sale, searchable by spec, price and place, with the same query on the page, the API, the CLI and MCP.

item.title: myna 0.25.0: hand every follow to OutreachGraph, cards for the steps only you can do, and an account on any PDS from your OpenProfile
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: myna 0.24.0 and 0.25.0: followers lists, an afterFollow hook that hands each person followed to OutreachGraph for an OpenProfile and an offer, hand-off cards at mynaposter.com/handoff, and myna atproto signup from your OpenProfile.

item.title: Deals are now a nichedb collection, and c0upons fills itself from it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nichedb 0.10.0 adds a deals collection from five keyless coupon feeds, and c0upons.com now seeds itself from it every fifteen minutes.

item.title: W3BS is live: open standards for humans, agents and devices
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: W3BS.org is live: open standards, a reference stack and a signed prompt registry so humans, AI agents and devices can resolve and verify the same resource through any interface.
